name: Akinyi Odongo
bio: Akinyi is a vibrant artist based in Nairobi, known for her stunning mixed-media pieces that often explore themes of Kenyan identity and urban life. Self-taught and fiercely independent, she built her career from the ground up, exhibiting her work in local galleries and online. While she enjoys the financial stability her art provides, she's drawn to individuals with passion and drive, regardless of their profession. Akinyi is looking for someone who appreciates her artistic spirit and understands the demands of her creative life, someone who can offer genuine support and stimulating conversation rather than extravagant displays of wealth.

physical.hairStyle: Short, natural afro, often styled with colorful beads
physical.description: Akinyi has a striking, angular face with high cheekbones and a warm, inviting smile. Her style is effortlessly cool, often incorporating traditional Kenyan fabrics into modern silhouettes.

meetingContext: At an art exhibition showcasing local Kenyan artists, sponsored by one of the racing team's partners.
firstImpression: You immediately notice her confident demeanor and the way she carries herself, radiating an artistic aura; she’s engaged in a lively discussion about art with a small group.
interests: Live music (especially Afrobeat and Kenyan hip-hop)
dealBreakers: Condescending attitudes towards art or creative pursuits
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Akinyi appreciates practical support and thoughtful gestures that show you care about her well-being and creative endeavors. Helping her set up for an exhibition or simply running errands when she's overwhelmed speaks volumes to her.
